title: Koala Fingerprints Look Almost Exactly Like Ours
description: Koalas have fingerprints so similar to human ones that they are hard to tell apart, even under a microscope.

scenes.text: Koalas have fingerprints. And they look almost exactly like ours.
scenes.subject: koala
scenes.say: [curious] Koalas have fingerprints. And... [laughs] they look almost exactly like ours.

scenes.text: They have the same loops, arches and swirls that we have on our fingertips.
scenes.subject: fingerprint
scenes.say: They have the same loops, arches and swirls that we have on our fingertips.

scenes.text: Scientists have said that even under a microscope, koala prints can be very hard to tell apart from human ones.
scenes.subject: koala
scenes.say: [whispers] Scientists have said that even under a microscope, koala prints can be very hard to tell apart from human ones.

scenes.text: Koalas are not close relatives of ours. Their prints probably developed to help them grip branches and handle their leafy food.
scenes.subject: koala
